title: Figures 103-104: cylinder UAP Mach number at 500 mph and pressure at 700 mph CFD
description: Two CFD contour plots of the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale and 223K. Figure 103 shows Mach number at 500 mph with mixed inlet and subsonic outlet; Figure 104 shows the pressure field (Pa) at 700 mph with mixed inlet and supersonic outlet, with a strong bow compression. Transonic cases in the BAASS cylinder study.
